title: Rebels Motorcycle Club (Canada)
reason: Retry recovered archived copies of the CISC 1999 annual report (one passage on Project KISS and eight former Rebels made Hells Angels full members on 18 September 1998), the CISC 2000 outlaw gangs summary (Project KISS, ten-month undercover operation on the Edmonton chapter, guilty pleas, about two and a half years), and the Last Link on the Left Joey Morin page (Morin long associated with the defunct Rebels, club closed 1997 after Scott Jamieson's arrest; 1997 clubhouse raid). With the onepercenterbikers summary this gives roughly 500 words of facts about the 1968-2004 club. Wolf's book (archive.org lending copy) and the Supreme Court 1974 ruling are not readable; Google Books pages thin; archive.org rate-limited. The 2023 Coleman page concerns a Rebels club of unconfirmed link, and the CBC page is about the Syndicate club. Below the 1,000-word floor; not padded.
